eligibility_rule: At least 30 implemented tasks, with at least 5 in one assessed tier. The board needs 3 such models.

measures.definition: The implementer scorecard's escaped regressions at severity weight, deduplicated against pre-landing review charges, compared with its size-adjusted expectation.
measures.label: Escaped regressions

measures.definition: +1 per first-pass accept, -1 per reject and -0.5 per accept-with-fixes on the row's candidates, summed per reviewed delivery and compared with the same combination of the scorecard's tier expectations.
measures.label: Review outcome

measures.definition: Required-check failures on the row's candidate heads classed code.
measures.label: Implementer CI failures
measures.reason: required-check failures are not recorded by cause yet

measures.definition: Final-recovery decisions whose fault is implementer.
measures.label: Implementer-fault final recoveries
measures.reason: final-recovery fault is recorded but the ranking measure is not yet computed

measures.definition: The implementer scorecard's crew-caused rework, which already leaves out review verdicts; CI failures are not yet classified by cause and final-recovery faults are not yet computed as a ranking measure, so neither is subtracted.
measures.label: Crew-caused rework

measures.definition: Orbit tool calls in the row's implementing activities classed expected or denied.
measures.label: Tool-call errors
measures.reason: tool audit events are not attributed to a model yet
